python_requires_reason: veinnet_runtime uses PEP 604 union type hints (e.g. `str | Path`, `float | int | None`), which require Python 3.10+ to be a supported/declared target even though `from __future__ import annotations` defers their evaluation at import time. The package must not claim compatibility with a Python version its syntax is not declared to support.
candidate_runtime_lock_note: These are the exact numpy/scipy/onnxruntime versions used for this ONNX's export/parity run on an x86_64 CUDA workstation (see export_provenance.json), re-verified to install and pass all tests on this development machine (macOS arm64, Python 3.12.5) via requirements.lock.txt + requirements-test.lock.txt. They are a CANDIDATE runtime set for Jetson, not a validated Jetson lock.

excluded_dependencies.torch: Not a runtime dependency. The ONNX graph contains the frozen weights; PyTorch checkpoints (.pt) are training-time artifacts only and are not shipped in or required by this bundle.

jetson_platform_verification_note: The candidate_runtime_lock versions above have NOT been installed or tested on Jetson Orin Nano aarch64 / the target JetPack release -- this must not be assumed or described as validated. Before shipping: (1) confirm a compatible onnxruntime build for the target JetPack release (JetPack images typically ship a JetPack-specific onnxruntime-gpu wheel with TensorRT/CUDA execution providers, which may pin a different onnxruntime version than 1.29.0), (2) confirm numpy/scipy wheels are available for that Python/JetPack combination (JetPack's system Python is commonly 3.8-3.10 depending on release -- confirm it satisfies python_requires >=3.10), (3) re-run every test in tests/ against the actual Jetson interpreter before deployment. Only after that pass may jetson_platform_verification be changed from "pending".
